question.en:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error:
"Neither the manager nor the employees was present (A) / at the annual general meeting (B) / held yesterday afternoon (C) / in the corporate auditorium (D)."
question.hi:
वाक्य के उस भाग की पहचान कीजिए जिसमें व्याकरण संबंधी त्रुटि है:
"Neither the manager nor the employees was present (A) / at the annual general meeting (B) / held yesterday afternoon (C) / in the corporate auditorium (D)."

options.en: Neither the manager nor the employees was present
options.hi: Neither the manager nor the employees was present

explanation.en: Rule: When two subjects are joined by "neither... nor", the verb agrees with the closer subject. Here "employees" is plural, so the verb must be "were present", not "was present".
explanation.hi: नियम: जब दो कर्ता "neither... nor" से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता (employees - बहुवचन) के अनुसार "were" होनी चाहिए।
